item.title: Undertone 1.27.0
item.description:
• Workspaces are now separate accounts: each has its own meetings, settings, AI keys and plan.
  • Add a workspace by signing in with another Google, Microsoft or email account, and switch between them without restarting.
  • Team features follow the account of the workspace you're in.

Undertone 1.26.2

  • Welcome screen whenever you're signed out. Opening Undertone without an account now shows the sign-in screen (Google, Microsoft, SSO or email), not only right after signing out. Choose "Continue without signing in" to keep using your own AI key.

Undertone 1.26.1

  • Welcome screen. After you sign out, Undertone greets you with one place to sign back in: Google, Microsoft, your company's SSO or an email code, with your last-used option marked. Using your own AI key? Continue without signing in.

Undertone 1.26.0

  • Sign in with Google or Microsoft. Use your work account to sign in to Undertone: one account for your credits, Pro and your team, no code to copy. Email codes and company SSO still work.

Undertone 1.25.0

  • Workspaces. Personal and each team workspace are now separate: their own meetings, tasks, memory, glossary, people, chats and sources. Switch at the bottom of the sidebar; spaces stay as sections inside each workspace.
  • Team, inside its workspace. The Team page, team glossary, notifications and sharing belong to the workspace you're in. Your meetings stay private until you share them.
  • Rules with your own tools. Workflow rules can run with each member's own connected Slack, Linear, Jira or HubSpot when the workspace hasn't connected that tool.
